bounded_host_request.command:
set -eu
printf 'GAYBBS_PREFLIGHT_V1\n'
printf 'PWD='; pwd
printf 'SOURCE_HEAD='; git rev-parse HEAD
printf 'SOURCE_BRANCH='; git branch --show-current
printf 'SOURCE_DIRTY_COUNT='; git status --porcelain --untracked-files=no | wc -l
printf 'USERBOT_ACTIVE='; systemctl --user is-active gace-userbot-verify.service || true
printf 'BOT_CONTAINERS='; docker ps --format '{{.Names}} {{.Image}}' | grep -Ei 'gaybbs|gateapp' || true
printf 'REPAIR_SCRIPT='; test -f scripts/repair_repeated_start_existing_posts.py && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'STATE_PATH='; test -d deploy/state/startless-repeated-start-repairs-20261122 && echo EXISTS || echo ABSENT
printf 'MIGRATION_FILE='; test -f scripts/migrate_existing_startless_public_posts.py && echo YES || echo NO
printf 'PROJECT_ROOT='; git rev-parse --show-toplevel
